duration.text: The Winter Short-term Chinese Language and Culture Courses at Nankai University is a 1 Month long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 472 USD/In total ￥ 3400 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Academic transcript of highest education

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizen 2. Be in good health 3. High school graduate 4. Aged between 18 and 60 years old 5. Hold a valid foreign passport. (If you are currently in China, you need to hold a valid Chinese visa as well.)
